queryVersion.queryString: PREFIX dbo: <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?city ?cityName ?population WHERE { VALUES ?minPopulation { UNDEF } ?city a dbo:City ; rdfs:label ?cityName ; dbo:populationTotal ?population . FILTER(?population > ?minPopulation) FILTER(LANG(?cityName) = "en")}ORDER BY DESC(?population) LIMIT 10
queryVersion.comment: Version 1 - Basic city population query with parameterization
